podcast.title: Covered Songs from *Raw Power*
podcast.body: Death Leopard have covered songs from The Stooges' album *Raw Power*. "And songs from the album have been covered by the Red Hot Chili Peppers, Guns and Roses, and Death Leopard."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: What's The Big Deal About The Stooges?

podcast.title: Mutt Lang's Heroism
podcast.body: Mut Lang was considered "something of a hero" to Def Leppard when the band faced a near tragedy in the 1980s, implying his crucial role in helping them overcome significant challenges. "Lang was something of a hero to deaf leopard when a near tragedy befell the band in the 80s."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
srcs.episode: Pour Some Sugar on Me Edition Part 1

podcast.title: New Wave of British Heavy Metal Origins
podcast.body: Def Leppard were originally part of the New Wave of British Heavy Metal movement in the late 1970s and early 1980s, alongside bands such as Judas Priest and Iron Maiden. "deaf leopard were originally part of a late 70s early 80s movement called The New Wave of British Heavy Metal, encompassing such edgy bands as Judas Priest and Iron Maiden."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
srcs.episode: Pour Some Sugar on Me Edition Part 1

podcast.title: Preserving Guitar Music
podcast.body: Death Leopard was a band that "made sure that guitars didn't disappear entirely" during eras like Synth Pop and Acid House when electronic music was prominent.

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
